verdict.rationale: Dynadot ships an in-product AI Domain Search that generates domain name and TLD suggestions from a keyword or phrase the user enters. That is genuine AI-generated suggestion inside the product, but it works from typed input, not from the user's account or portfolio data. The MCP server only lets an external AI assistant manage domains, so it does not count as in-product insight. Missing for 10: AI insights drawn from the user's own account or portfolio data (e.g., renewal, DNS or portfolio recommendations), in-product analytics or insight surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Dynadot AI Domain Search generates domain name suggestions from your keyword or phrase, including suggested domain names and suggested TLDs
Get brandable domain ideas and check availability instantly across top TLDs.
